title: Berlin Observation Decks - Quick Summary
items: **Berlin has five public high viewpoints, and they are not the same experience.** They run from the free Reichstag dome at about 24 m to the enclosed TV Tower deck at 203 m, with real differences in price, booking, and whether you stand in the open air.

**The TV Tower (Fernsehturm) is the highest and most iconic, but the most expensive.** The 203 m deck starts around €24.50 online, uses dynamic pricing that climbs closer to the date, and the walk-up queue can be long. Book a timed slot ahead.

**The Panoramapunkt at Potsdamer Platz is the best all-round value.** €9 buys an open-air terrace 100 m up, reached by the fastest lift in Europe in 20 seconds, plus an open-air exhibition on Potsdamer Platz history. It is my pick for most visitors.

**The Park Inn Panorama Terrasse is the cheapest ticketed roof and the best TV Tower photo.** €6 gets you onto an open 39th-floor rooftop at Alexanderplatz that faces the tower head-on, and it is almost never crowded.
**The Reichstag dome is free but needs advance ID registration**, and the Victory Column is about €4 in cash for 285 open-air steps in the Tiergarten. Both are worth it if you plan for how they work.
**Use the Viewpoint Finder below to match a view to your budget, timing, and whether you want open air or the highest deck.**
